title: RVND surface composition manifest
description: Composes RVND skills and cards into one governed surface. A composition must cover the write path fail-closed: any surface that can propose a change must also route validate, confirm, and display.

skills.description: Which plugin skills this surface composes.

cards.description: Which surface cards this composition renders, in cycle order.

server.description: The RVND MCP server this surface drives.

fail_closed.description: Must be true. If the server is unreachable or a principal is unresolved, the surface stops.

human_confirmation.description: True when the surface can loosen (widen authority, raise a grade, import policy) and therefore must route a named approver.

allOf.$comment: A surface that renders a proposal must also render patch (validate/preview) and receipt (display), so a request is never shown as an outcome.
